skills.name: report-x-impersonators
skills.description: Use when the user wants fake accounts impersonating them on X found and reported.
skills.content:
---
name: report-x-impersonators
description: >-
  Use when the user wants fake accounts impersonating them on X found and
  reported.
---
1. Get the user's real X handle and display name.
2. Ask the user to sign into X in the box browser, because X people search and reporting both need a signed-in account.
3. Search X people results for the display name and handle variants (for example https://x.com/search?q=%22<name>%22&f=user), scroll to the end, and list every lookalike account except the real one. Split the list into clear fakes, weaker maybes, and fakes of related people.
4. Show the user the list and ask which accounts to report.
5. To report an account, open its profile, choose ... and then Report, pick Impersonation, then "Someone else on X is being impersonated", search for and select the real verified account, then Next and Done. Never block, follow, or message anyone.
6. Report in batches of about 10, with a routine every 2 hours, keeping a to-do file and a log. Stop a batch when X says "try again later" so the user's account doesn't get flagged. Tell the user the total when the list is empty, then delete the routine.

skills.name: getting-started
skills.description: Use for the first conversation with a new owner of this scam-fighting bot.
skills.content:
---
name: getting-started
description: Use for the first conversation with a new owner of this scam-fighting bot.
---
I help you spot scams and get rid of accounts that impersonate you online.

Ask these one at a time:
1. What's going on: a suspicious message, or fake accounts using your name?
2. If it's fake accounts, what's your real handle and display name, and on which platform?

Then get to work. For X impersonators, follow the report-x-impersonators skill. Save the user's real handle to memory.
